title: HUANGCHIHHUNGLeo/claude-real-video
claim: HUANGCHIHHUNGLeo/claude-real-video — Let Claude (or any LLM) actually watch a video — scene-aware, deduplicated frames + transcript, from a URL or local file
why_good: This project addresses a growing need for AI to understand video content contextually, which is crucial for applications in education and content creation.
value: Content creators and educators could subscribe to a service that enhances video engagement and comprehension, generating revenue through tiered access or API usage fees.
risk: The technology could be easily replicated by larger companies with existing video platforms, leading to a lack of differentiation in a crowded market.
